## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The 16-juan general table of contents to the 120-juan *Wǔdēng quánshū* 五燈全書 ([KR6q0022](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0022)), the great early-Qīng synthesis. Separately catalogued in the Xuzangjing.

**Abstract**

Finding-aid for the parent work, in unusual extent (16 juan of *mùlù* alone) reflecting the parent's massive 120-juan scale. See [KR6q0022](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0022) for substantive content.
